Online English Tutor

Example LearningRemote (Worldwide)Posted Sep 9, 2026

RemotePart-timeEntry LevelDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for an online tutor delivering one-to-one English lessons to adult learners, using a supplied curriculum and lesson plans.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver scheduled one-to-one video lessons
  • Adapt supplied lesson plans to each learner's level
  • Leave short written feedback after every session
  • Track learner progress in the platform

Requirements

  • Native or near-native English
  • Stable internet, webcam and headset
  • Patient, encouraging teaching style
  • Teaching certification is a plus, not a requirement

Benefits

  • Set your own availability
  • Lesson materials provided
  • Weekly payouts

Skills

TeachingESLLesson PlanningVideo ConferencingFeedback
